= BOM Detection Test Fixtures

Test fixtures for verifying the invisible character and BOM detection linter in `dogfood-gate.yml`.

== Test Cases

=== Clean Files (Should Not Be Flagged)

* `clean.rs` — No BOM, no invisible characters
* `normal-whitespace.rs` — Normal whitespace (tabs, CR, LF) that should not trigger detection

=== Files That Should Be Flagged

* `leading-bom.rs` — UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF) at start of file
  - **Critical:** grep strips leading BOM before matching, so the pattern-based check alone cannot detect it
  - Requires separate byte-wise check: `head -c 3 "$file" | od -An -tx1 | grep -q "ef bb bf"`

* `corrupted-workflow.yml` — Contains C0 control character (backspace 0x08)
  - YAML parsers reject control characters, making such files unparseable
  - The C0 range `\x01-\x08,\x0B,\x0C,\x0E-\x1F` is now included in the pattern
  - TAB (0x09), LF (0x0A), and CR (0x0D) are excluded as legitimate whitespace

== Verification

Run the linter pattern manually to verify:

[source,bash]
----
# Pattern-based check (catches mid-file BOMs and C0 controls)
PATTERNS='(*UTF)[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x{a0}\x{ad}\x{200b}-\x{200f}\x{202a}-\x{202f}\x{2060}\x{2066}-\x{2069}\x{feff}]'
grep -aPl "$PATTERNS" tests/fixtures/bom-detection/*.rs tests/fixtures/bom-detection/*.yml

# Byte-wise leading-BOM check
find tests/fixtures/bom-detection -type f \
  -exec sh -c 'head -c 3 "$1" | od -An -tx1 | grep -q "ef bb bf" && echo "$1"' _ {} \;
----

== Expected Results

[cols="2,1,3"]
|===
| File | Should Be Flagged | Reason

| clean.rs | No | Clean file
| normal-whitespace.rs | No | Only legitimate whitespace
| leading-bom.rs | Yes | Leading UTF-8 BOM (byte-wise check)
| corrupted-workflow.yml | Yes | C0 control character (pattern check)
|===

== References

* Issue: hyperpolymath/empty-linter#70
* Root cause: UTF-8 byte sequences vs. Unicode codepoints in PCRE patterns
* Fix: Codepoint escapes + C0 range + `grep -a` + separate leading-BOM check
